description: ESRI Data & Maps 2004 : U.S. Highways is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Geographic Data Technology, Inc., Environmental Systems Research Institute (Redlands, Calif.). U.S. Highways represents the major and minor highways of the United States. These include Interstates, US Highways, State Highways, major roads, and minor roads. This dataset is a subset of the Streets dataset. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository.
